source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Eye opening, verbal response, and motor response, providing an objective, standardized measure of level of consciousness","B":"A tool generally considered to lack any clearly established clinical use in assessing a client's neurological status","C":"Mainly the client's blood pressure and heart rate, rather than their overall level of consciousness","D":"Only the client's pupillary response, without incorporating any of the other components this scale actually includes"}}
source_row.rationale: The Glasgow Coma Scale evaluates eye opening, verbal response, and motor response, providing an objective, standardized measure of level of consciousness widely used to assess and monitor neurological status, particularly following traumatic brain injury.
